resources.string: Also includes saved categories, payment methods and preferences.
Shared history stays an offline copy. It does not join groups or upload to an account.
Restore keeps the saved entries, splits, guest shares, confirmation states and subscription checkpoints. It requires an empty local ledger and does not replace or merge existing data.
Switch to On this phone before restoring a complete archive.
This ledger already has data. Choose an empty local ledger to restore this archive.
This archive could not be read. Choose a supported complete archive.
The file is not encrypted and contains your full financial history and bill photos. Keep it somewhere private and share it only with someone you trust.
Includes entries, splits and guest shares, friends, groups and memberships, settlement states, subscriptions and checkpoints, saved asks, bill photos, categories, payment methods and preferences.
Only data held on this phone is included, using its latest saved edits. This does not fetch server history or include login credentials or consent choices.
